description: Read one note from the user's Obsidian vault in full: its markdown, frontmatter, tags, the notes and brain objects its wikilinks point at, and the notes that link back to it. Identify it by object_id (from a search), by vault path ('Projects/Ada.md'), or by title. Use this whenever a search result looks like the answer — the search returns an excerpt, this returns the note. Follow the backlinks when the user asks how something connects to the rest of their thinking.

path.description: Vault path ('Meetings/2026-08-20 Ada.md'), filename, or note title.

vault_id.description: Which vault to look in, when several are synced.

name: get_obsidian_note
title: Read vault note
